title: Remediation
new.title: New remediation session
session.title: Remediation session
apply.propose.title: Propose fixes
apply.propose.intro: Choose the pending groups (or single items) and the mode. Nothing is written to SAP in this step.
apply.propose.modeKbHint: Applies the solution already recorded in the KB for the same pattern.
apply.propose.modeIaHint: Ignores the KB and analyses the code, the check message and the SAP note (more expensive).
apply.propose.auto: Automatic mode (confirms and applies without asking)
apply.propose.autoUnavailable: Available only for sessions in no-confirmation mode.
apply.propose.autoWarnTitle: Warning: automatic mode writes to SAP
apply.propose.autoWarn: Confirms the KB when there is no alert (or the AI when there is no card) and applies straight away with the session request. The waiver is valid for this batch only. The process stops and hands back to you on:
apply.propose.stop2: Z copy of a standard object;
apply.review.title: Proposal review
apply.review.intro: Check each proposal and decide. Confirming does not write to SAP; writing is the next step.
apply.review.empty: No items with a proposal. Generate proposals in the previous step.
apply.review.noProposal: This item has no proposal yet.
apply.review.alreadyApplied: This item was already applied in SAP.
apply.review.redecide: Already decided; you can decide again.
apply.decision.replacesHint: Comma-separated ids. The new AI card takes their place.
apply.decision.factsHint: Tick the facts that should be recorded in the KB.
apply.decision.ConfirmIa.title: Confirm the AI proposal ({{count}})
apply.decision.ConfirmIa.description: Saves the decision and the AI solution as a new KB card. Nothing is written to SAP.
apply.decision.Cancel.title: Cancel items ({{count}})
apply.decision.Exemption.title: Exempt items ({{count}})
apply.decision.Exemption.description: Marks the items for an exemption request.
apply.apply.title: Simulate and apply to SAP
apply.apply.intro: Select the confirmed items. Simulate first (does not change SAP: checks the active version and takes the backup); then confirm the write.
apply.apply.production: This is a production system: writing is blocked.
apply.apply.noRequest: The session has no request. Set the request to write to SAP.
apply.apply.empty: No confirmed items with a proposal.
apply.apply.allowTableHint: Tick only if the table conversion is accepted; otherwise the write is aborted.
apply.confirm.title: Write to SAP?
apply.confirm.description: This will write to SAP {{system}}, on request {{request}}.
apply.confirm.production: Writing to production is not allowed.
apply.confirm.ack: I confirm writing these objects on request {{request}}.
apply.result.activationQuestion: The source was written inactive. What now?
new.description: Create the session from an ATC extraction or import the CSV.
list.description: Remediation sessions by environment and cycle.
header.author: Author
header.totals: {{total}} items in {{objects}} objects ({{pendingObjects}} with pending items)
new.fileHint: The CSV exported from ATC (original columns).
import.shifted: {{count}} rows with shifted columns were realigned.
item.title: Item {{n}}
item.sheetEmpty: There is no correction sheet for this item yet.
decision.title: Decision
decision.help.Cancel: The item is no longer handled in this remediation.
decision.help.Exemption: The item goes to the ATC exemption request; the remark is required.
decision.help.Reset: Clears the item status and remark.
groups.summary: {{pending}} pending · batch of {{items}} items in {{objects}} objects (limit {{batch}})
export.title: Export status
export.description: Downloads the original ATC CSV with the remediation status column (atc_status.csv).
reuse.title: Reuse sheets
reuse.description: Looks in another session of the same environment for handled items that also apply to this one.
reuse.noOther: There is no other session in this environment.
monitor.description: Sessions of every customer with the item situation and the remediation in progress. Press play in the session's Items tab.
auto.scopeSelected: {{count}} selected item(s) go through every step without stopping.
auto.scopeAllPending: The session's {{count}} pending items go through every step without stopping.
auto.step.triage: Triage: rules R1 to R9 (R1 checked in the dictionary); the baseline was already left out when the session was created.
auto.step.propose: Propose the fix from the knowledge base; without a solution there, from the AI.
auto.step.confirm: Confirm automatically: knowledge base without alerts; AI only with syntax ok and no alerts.
auto.step.apply: Simulate (with backup), review by AI and apply in SAP what passes.
auto.step.report: Build the batch report and the summary to export.
auto.locksTitle: Safeguards: whatever does not pass stays pending for you
auto.lock.ai: Proposals with alerts, business doubts, or suggested exemption or cancellation are not applied.
auto.lock.review: The AI review can block an item from being applied.
auto.lock.standard: SAP standard objects are neither read nor changed.
auto.lock.errors: Activation or write errors, or table changes that need conversion, leave the item to you (no automatic rollback).
auto.target: Writes to environment {{system}}, request {{request}}. Production environments are blocked.
auto.noRequest: The session has no request: set the request to be able to apply.
auto.ack: I confirm writing to SAP in request {{request}}.
items.sap.detail.Sap.WriteBlockedProduct: Write blocked: the system is registered as production.
items.sap.detail.Sap.WriteBlockedCategor: Write blocked: the client category (T000) could not be confirmed.
item.applyFailedTitle: Writing to SAP failed: the code was not changed
auto.scopeAllWithErrors: The {{count}} pending items and the {{errors}} with an SAP error go through every step without stopping.
auto.step.retry: Items with an SAP error (request, lock, write): re-apply without a new proposal – simulate, review and apply again. Activation errors and rollbacks stay with you.
item.approvalTitle: Awaiting approval – {{suggestion}}. Decide in the Items tab (accept the suggestion, exemption, cancel) or in the Proposals and application tab.
decision.help.AcceptSuggestion: Each item gets what its proposal recommends: exemption, cancellation or confirmation of the fix (then apply it in Proposals and application). An empty note uses the proposal's justification. Items without a solution stay as they are.
decision.doneSkipped: {{count}} item(s) decided; {{skipped}} with no suggestion to accept stayed as they were.
auto.triageRulesHint: Set by the session's project type, according to the triage rules register.
auto.confirmAll.title: Process all items?
auto.confirmAll.description: No item selected: the {{pending}} pending items and the {{errors}} with an SAP error will be processed.
auto.confirmAll.hint: To process only some, cancel and select the items in the list.
sources.autoDescription: Sources of the pending items are read right after the items are loaded (standard objects are left out; the cache is reused).
sources.notStartedHint: The play reads the missing sources before proposing fixes.
triage.readOnly: Rules the triage considers in this session ({{projectType}} project), in evaluation order. Triage runs in the play.
triage.noRules: No active rule for this project type.
sources.summary: {{read}} of {{total}} objects with source read. Reading is automatic: when the items are loaded and in the play.
